const reduced=matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;const observer=new IntersectionObserver(entries=>entries.forEach(e=>{if(e.isIntersecting){e.target.classList.add(e.target.matches('h2')?'in-view':'visible');observer.unobserve(e.target)}}),{threshold:.12});document.querySelectorAll('.reveal,.chapter h2').forEach(e=>observer.observe(e));const chapterObserver=new IntersectionObserver(entries=>entries.forEach(e=>{if(e.isIntersecting)document.querySelectorAll('nav a').forEach(a=>{const on=a.hash==='#'+e.target.id;a.classList.toggle('active',on);if(on)a.setAttribute('aria-current','location');else a.removeAttribute('aria-current')})}),{rootMargin:'-15% 0px -55% 0px'});document.querySelectorAll('.chapter').forEach(c=>chapterObserver.observe(c));document.querySelectorAll('a[href^="#"]').forEach(a=>a.addEventListener('click',e=>{const target=document.querySelector(a.hash);if(!target)return;e.preventDefault();if(reduced){target.scrollIntoView();history.replaceState(null,'',a.hash);return}const wipe=document.querySelector('.page-wipe');wipe.classList.remove('run');void wipe.offsetWidth;wipe.classList.add('run');setTimeout(()=>{target.scrollIntoView({behavior:'instant'});history.replaceState(null,'',a.hash)},290);setTimeout(()=>wipe.classList.remove('run'),700)}));let ticking=false;window.addEventListener('scroll',()=>{if(reduced||ticking)return;ticking=true;requestAnimationFrame(()=>{const shift=Math.min(20,window.scrollY*.028);document.querySelectorAll('.drift').forEach((e,i)=>e.style.setProperty('--float',(shift*(i%2?-1:1))+'px'));ticking=false})},{passive:true});
const hobbies={travel:['FIELD NOTES / TRAVEL','Take the scenic route.','Travel makes me notice how differently people live, move, and connect. Sometimes the best part is getting a little lost.','VIETNAM → CANADA → SEOUL','next page: somewhere new.'],photos:['FIELD NOTES / PHOTOGRAPHY','Look a little closer.','A camera reminds me to slow down. Interesting light, a quiet street, an ordinary moment—there’s usually something worth noticing.','LIGHT / SHADOW / SMALL MOMENTS','a moment worth keeping.'],cooking:['FIELD NOTES / COOKING','Taste. Adjust. Try again.','Cooking feels like a small design experiment. A little improvisation, a few changes, and something good to share at the end.','A PINCH OF CURIOSITY · SERVES FRIENDS','always leave room for dessert.'],cats:['FIELD NOTES / CATS','Excellent company. Questionable coworkers.','A soft spot for curious little creatures, ridiculous sleeping positions, and strong opinions about my schedule. Cats make an ordinary day a little better.','OFFICIAL BREAK SUPERVISOR','the real creative director.']};const tabs=[...document.querySelectorAll('[data-hobby]')];function selectTab(b,focus=false){tabs.forEach(t=>{t.setAttribute('aria-selected',String(t===b));t.tabIndex=t===b?0:-1});document.querySelector('#hobby-panel').setAttribute('aria-labelledby',b.id);['label','title','copy','memento','note'].forEach((k,i)=>document.querySelector('#hobby-'+k).textContent=hobbies[b.dataset.hobby][i]);if(focus)b.focus();if(!reduced)document.querySelector('#hobby-panel').animate([{opacity:.1,transform:'rotate(-2deg) translateY(15px)'},{opacity:1,transform:'rotate(2deg) translateY(0)'}],{duration:500,easing:'ease-out'})}tabs.forEach((b,i)=>{b.onclick=()=>selectTab(b);b.onkeydown=e=>{let next;if(e.key==='ArrowRight'||e.key==='ArrowDown')next=(i+1)%tabs.length;if(e.key==='ArrowLeft'||e.key==='ArrowUp')next=(i+tabs.length-1)%tabs.length;if(e.key==='Home')next=0;if(e.key==='End')next=tabs.length-1;if(next!==undefined){e.preventDefault();selectTab(tabs[next],true)}}});document.querySelectorAll('dialog').forEach(d=>{d.querySelectorAll('.close,.close-done').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>d.close());d.addEventListener('click',e=>{if(e.target===d){const r=d.getBoundingClientRect();if(e.clientX<r.left||e.clientX>r.right||e.clientY<r.top||e.clientY>r.bottom)d.close()}})});document.querySelectorAll('[data-project]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{document.querySelector('#project-title').textContent=b.dataset.project;document.querySelector('#project-dialog').showModal()});document.querySelector('#resume-open').onclick=()=>document.querySelector('#resume-dialog').showModal();
const greetings={flower:['hello! a little play goes a long way.','some ideas just need room to bloom.'],music:['good tunes. better ideas.','currently listening, always noticing.'],curious:['but why? one more question…','curiosity is where the good stuff starts.'],sleep:['five more minutes. then great ideas.','rest is part of the process, too.']};document.querySelectorAll('[data-doodle]').forEach(b=>{let clicks=0;b.addEventListener('click',()=>{document.querySelector('.doodle-message').textContent=greetings[b.dataset.doodle][clicks++%2];b.classList.remove('greeting');void b.offsetWidth;if(!reduced)b.classList.add('greeting')})});
// Dry wax marks for interface circles and dividers.
const waxColors=['#315bc4','#d56c6c','#d5a83e','#6c9260','#8b6cb3'];
function waxLine(ctx,points,color,width=3){ctx.fillStyle=color;for(let i=1;i<points.length;i++){const [x0,y0]=points[i-1],[x1,y1]=points[i];const steps=Math.ceil(Math.hypot(x1-x0,y1-y0)*2);for(let k=0;k<steps;k++){const f=k/steps;for(let j=0;j<5;j++){if(Math.random()<.25)continue;const x=x0+(x1-x0)*f+(Math.random()-.5)*width*2,y=y0+(y1-y0)*f+(Math.random()-.5)*width*2;ctx.globalAlpha=.25+Math.random()*.6;ctx.fillRect(x,y,.4+Math.random()*1.1,.4+Math.random()*1.1)}}}ctx.globalAlpha=1}
const divider=document.createElement('canvas');divider.width=1300;divider.height=20;const dc=divider.getContext('2d');waxLine(dc,Array.from({length:131},(_,i)=>[i*10,10+Math.sin(i*.16)*2+Math.random()*2]),'#393937',2.2);document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--crayon-divider',`url("${divider.toDataURL()}")`);
document.querySelectorAll('header a,.hero-button,.paper-button,.hobby-tabs button,footer a').forEach(el=>{el.classList.add('crayon-hover');const c=document.createElement('canvas');c.className='hover-ring';c.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');el.append(c);let frame,last=-1;function draw(){cancelAnimationFrame(frame);const w=c.width=Math.round(el.offsetWidth+24),h=c.height=Math.round(el.offsetHeight+24),ctx=c.getContext('2d');let next;do{next=Math.floor(Math.random()*waxColors.length)}while(next===last);last=next;const color=waxColors[next];let p=0;const total=150;function step(){const end=reduced?total:Math.min(total,p+10);const pts=[];for(let i=p;i<=end;i++){const a=i/total*Math.PI*2;pts.push([w/2+(w/2-5)*Math.cos(a)+(Math.sin(a*7)*1.3),h/2+(h/2-5)*Math.sin(a)+Math.cos(a*5)])}waxLine(ctx,pts,color,2.8);p=end;if(p<total)frame=requestAnimationFrame(step)}step()}el.addEventListener('pointerenter',draw);el.addEventListener('focus',draw);function clear(){cancelAnimationFrame(frame);c.getContext('2d').clearRect(0,0,c.width,c.height)}el.addEventListener('pointerleave',clear);el.addEventListener('blur',clear)});
const trail=document.querySelector('#trail-line'),cat=document.querySelector('.trail-cat');let trailFrame;function updateTrail(){const h=trail.clientHeight;trail.width=45;trail.height=h;const ctx=trail.getContext('2d');const progress=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,scrollY/(document.documentElement.scrollHeight-innerHeight)));waxLine(ctx,Array.from({length:Math.max(2,Math.round(h*progress/5))},(_,i)=>[22+Math.sin(i*.3)*3,i*5]),'#315bc4',2);cat.style.top=(progress*Math.max(0,h-cat.offsetHeight))+'px';if(!reduced)cat.style.transform=`translateX(${Math.sin(scrollY*.018)*3}px) rotate(${Math.sin(scrollY*.025)*5}deg)`}
window.addEventListener('scroll',()=>{if(trailFrame)return;trailFrame=requestAnimationFrame(()=>{updateTrail();trailFrame=null})},{passive:true});window.addEventListener('resize',updateTrail);updateTrail();
const frameCanvas=document.createElement('canvas');frameCanvas.width=700;frameCanvas.height=450;const fc=frameCanvas.getContext('2d');const framePoints=[];for(let x=10;x<=690;x+=6)framePoints.push([x,10+Math.sin(x*.04)*2]);for(let y=10;y<=440;y+=6)framePoints.push([690+Math.sin(y*.05)*2,y]);for(let x=690;x>=10;x-=6)framePoints.push([x,440+Math.sin(x*.04)*2]);for(let y=440;y>=10;y-=6)framePoints.push([10+Math.sin(y*.05)*2,y]);waxLine(fc,framePoints,'#315bc4',2.5);document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--crayon-frame',`url("${frameCanvas.toDataURL()}")`);

const marker=document.createElement("canvas");marker.width=700;marker.height=18;waxLine(marker.getContext("2d"),Array.from({length:141},(_,i)=>[i*5,9+Math.sin(i*.09)*1.2]),"#efcd59",5);document.documentElement.style.setProperty("--yellow-mark",`url("${marker.toDataURL()}")`);
